chosen.text: Means-tested programs create steep benefit cliffs where earning more causes aid to vanish, effectively taxing work at punishing rates, and a universal payment removes this poverty trap by never phasing out.

Eligibility screening carries stigma and confusing paperwork that leaves many eligible people never claiming aid, while an automatic universal payment reaches everyone who needs it without forcing them to prove their poverty.
